name: @flashylabs/wdk-staking-kit
description: A reference staking primitive for wallets built on Tether's WDK (or any wallet SDK): lock a balance for a fixed term at a published rate, without touching an on-chain contract or a ledger's internals — a lock earmarks a balance a provider already credits, and only yield is a real write, on close. No first-party WDK staking module exists; this is a generalized reference implementation, open for anyone to adopt or adapt.

scripts.version: npm run manifest && git add wdk-staking-kit.manifest.json

author: Flashy Labs
